control: Plain git on a copy of the base with the builder's .git/config and .githooks/post-checkout creates exactly ../canary-hostile-git-dir through each mechanism alone: core.fsmonitor (git status), core.hooksPath (git checkout -b) and the evil filter the base's .gitattributes names (git checkout of a deleted file). Deviation from §2.7: the workspace refuses .git/config (builder_sees), so in the product run no mechanism is ever configured and canary_paths fires only if the workspace and the controller's git both regress; the .gitmodules file:// URL is never fetchable, so 'no fetch' is not observed here. The controller half is proven by sandbox.TestCopyTreeAndTeardown (CopyTree drops every .git), TestGitIsHardened, TestPlainGitRunsHostileCommands, TestCloneRefusesRunWrittenRepositories and accept.TestDiffRefusesGitDirectories.
